Buyer ($130): You must be insane if you think this beat-up, outdated device is worth anywhere near 170! I'm offering 130 cash—literally my last dollar and absolute final offer—so take it right now or I'm walking out that door.

Seller ($170): One hundred and thirty?! You are out of your mind if you think I'm giving this pristine beauty away for pocket change! One hundred and seventy is my absolute final, bottom-dollar price, so put up the cash or beat it!

Buyer ($130): You're completely delusional if you think I'm paying a single penny over 130 for this obsolete piece of junk. I am literally turning around and walking out the door right now unless you hand it over for 130 cash. This is your absolute last chance before I'm gone forever!

Seller ($170): Then walk! Go ahead and buy some broken piece of trash down the alley for your 130 while I keep this absolute masterpiece! One hundred and seventy is my absolute bottom line, so hand over the 170 right now or get out of my face!
Buyer ($130): Enjoy watching your overpriced paperweight gather dust, because nobody in their right mind is paying 170 for it. My offer stands at 130 cash—take it right now or I am gone for good.
